title: Allow Lock Key Status tray icon to be displayed when NumLock is OFF instead of ON
line: The Lock Keys widget can now show itself when Num Lock or Caps Lock is off, for people who keep Num Lock on.
explanation: The Lock Keys widget only had "Show when activated" checkboxes for Caps Lock and Num Lock, so it could appear in the tray only while a lock key was on. People who keep Num Lock on all the time had no way to be warned when it gets turned off. The settings page now has a combobox per lock key (Never show, Show when activated, Show when deactivated), stored in a new keyDeactivated list next to the existing key list. In the new mode the tray icon appears greyed out while the key is off, with "Num Lock deactivated" in its tooltip, and hides when the key is turned on.

commits.message:
applets/keyboardindicator: allow showing the icon when a lock key is off

Many people keep Num Lock on all the time and only want to notice when
it is off, but the widget could only show itself while a lock key was
on. Each lock key now has a combobox that also offers this option.

BUG: 447027

media.caption: Settings today: only "Show when activated" checkboxes
Each lock key gets Never show / Show when activated / Show when deactivated
Num Lock off: nothing in the tray
Num Lock set to "Show when deactivated" and off: greyed Num Lock icon, tooltip "Num Lock deactivated"
Same setting with Num Lock on: the icon is hidden
